name: Clean cup (long settle)
summary: Hoffmann-style: skim the crust, let the grounds settle, and never plunge. Clean cup with little sediment.

steps.title: Add the water
steps.instruction: Add the grounds and pour all the water in about 10 seconds.
steps.why: A quick pour wets everything evenly and starts extraction together.

steps.title: Steep
steps.instruction: Leave it alone with the lid off.
steps.why: About four minutes of undisturbed steeping while the crust of grounds forms on top.

steps.title: Break the crust
steps.instruction: Stir the crust gently so it sinks, then scoop off the foam and any floating grounds with two spoons.
steps.why: Removing the floaters is what keeps the cup clean.

steps.title: Let it settle
steps.instruction: Wait for the rest of the grounds to sink. Five minutes minimum; up to eight is fine.
steps.why: Gravity does the filtering, so the cup has far less silt.

steps.title: Rest the plunger and pour
steps.instruction: Rest the plunger just above the surface without pressing. Pour slowly and stop before the sludge at the bottom.
steps.why: Pressing would stir the settled fines back into the cup.

sources.title: Honest Coffee Guide: James Hoffmann French press
Volcanica Coffee: French press technique, 3 recipes tested
